description: The pie chart presents the distribution of task categories in the MMRA benchmark and contains 11 slices, each labeled with a count and percentage. The slices are ObservationAngle (mint/teal) at 126 (12.28%), SimilarMaterial (orange) at 106 (10.33%), SubEvent (red/coral) at 100 (9.74%), UsageSimilarity (salmon) at 100 (9.65%), Environment (dark teal) at 90 (8.77%), Layout (pale yellow) at 90 (8.77%), AppearanceSimilarity (light green) at 90 (8.77%), SimilarEvent (light blue) at 90 (8.77%), MentalitySimilarity (light cyan) at 89 (8.67%), RelativePosition (light gray) at 81 (7.90%), and NearSameEntity (dark gray) at 63 (6.34%). Percentage labels are shown directly on or near the slices, there is no separate legend visible, and none of the slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the slice sizes appear roughly ordered from larger on the left/top-left toward smaller near the top.
caption_used: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of different tasks in the MMRA benchmark, with a total of 11 categories represented. The largest category, 'ObservationAngle,' accounts for approximately 15% of the total samples, while 'SimilarMaterial' and 'SubEvent' follow closely at 12% and 11%, respectively. 'NearSameEntity,' the smallest category, represents only 5% of the benchmark. The chart highlights that 'Environment' and 'Layout' have identical proportions, each contributing 10% to the dataset. The percentages within each slice are labeled for clarity, and the chart is color-coded to distinguish the categories effectively.
